_comment: Class abilities (generated by tools/gen_classes.py; hand-tune there). type is a display category (nuke/heal/dot/hot/buff/debuff/cc/pet/utility/passive/discipline); effects drive the mechanics. cost is paid from resource. Passives name the skill they represent; their level matches the class skill unlock. position 'behind' means the user must stand behind the target.
